text: Ibrutinib acts as a potent, irreversible inhibitor of Bruton’s tyrosine kinase (BTK) by forming a covalent bond with the cysteine-481 (Cys481) residue in the enzyme's ATP-binding pocket. This specific interaction blocks the downstream B-cell receptor (BCR) signaling pathway, which is constitutively hyperactivated in Mantle Cell Lymphoma (MCL) and essential for malignant B-cell survival and proliferation. By achieving high-affinity, sustained inhibition of BTK, Ibrutinib effectively induces apoptosis and disrupts the tumor microenvironment, providing a targeted therapeutic strategy that significantly improves clinical outcomes in relapsed or refractory MCL patients.
